record.bible_text: Moreover the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Also, thou son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> unto the land<WH0127> of Israel<WH03478>; An end<WH07093>, the end<WH07093> is come<WH0935><WTH8804> upon the four<WH0702> corners<WH03671> of the land<WH0776>.

Now <FI>is<Fi> the end<WH07093> <FI>come<Fi> upon thee, and I will send<WH07971><WTH8765> mine anger<WH0639> upon thee, and will judge<WH08199><WTH8804> thee according to thy ways<WH01870>, and will recompense<WH05414><WTH8804> upon thee all thine abominations<WH08441>. <RF>recompense: Heb. give<Rf>

And mine eye<WH05869> shall not spare<WH02347><WTH8799> thee, neither will I have pity<WH02550><WTH8799>: but I will recompense<WH05414><WTH8799> thy ways<WH01870> upon thee, and thine abominations<WH08441> shall be in the midst<WH08432> of thee: and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.
Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; An evil<WH07451>, an only<WH0259> evil<WH07451>, behold, is come<WH0935><WTH8802>.

An end<WH07093> is come<WH0935><WTH8804>, the end<WH07093> is come<WH0935><WTH8804>: it watcheth<WH06974><WTH8689> for thee; behold, it is come<WH0935><WTH8802>. <RF>watcheth for: Heb. awaketh against<Rf>

The morning<WH06843> is come<WH0935><WTH8804> unto thee, O thou that dwellest<WH03427><WTH8802> in the land<WH0776>: the time<WH06256> is come<WH0935><WTH8804><WTH8676><WH0935><WTH8802>, the day<WH03117> of trouble<WH04103> <FI>is<Fi> near<WH07138>, and not the sounding again<WH01906> of the mountains<WH02022>. <RF>sounding...: or, echo<Rf>

Now will I shortly<WH07138> pour out<WH08210><WTH8799> my fury<WH02534> upon thee, and accomplish<WH03615><WTH8765> mine anger<WH0639> upon thee: and I will judge<WH08199><WTH8804> thee according to thy ways<WH01870>, and will recompense<WH05414><WTH8804> thee for all thine abominations<WH08441>.

And mine eye<WH05869> shall not spare<WH02347><WTH8799>, neither will I have pity<WH02550><WTH8799>: I will recompense<WH05414><WTH8799> thee according to thy ways<WH01870> and thine abominations<WH08441> <FI>that<Fi> are in the midst<WH08432> of thee; and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> that smiteth<WH05221><WTH8688>. <RF>thee according: Heb. upon thee, etc<Rf>

Behold the day<WH03117>, behold, it is come<WH0935><WTH8802>: the morning<WH06843> is gone forth<WH03318><WTH8804>; the rod<WH04294> hath blossomed<WH06692><WTH8804>, pride<WH02087> hath budded<WH06524><WTH8804>.

Violence<WH02555> is risen up<WH06965><WTH8804> into a rod<WH04294> of wickedness<WH07562>: none of them <FI>shall remain<Fi> , nor of their multitude<WH01995>, nor of any<WH01991> of theirs: neither <FI>shall there be<Fi> wailing<WH05089> for them. <RF>theirs: or, their tumultuous persons: Heb. tumult<Rf>

The time<WH06256> is come<WH0935><WTH8804>, the day<WH03117> draweth near<WH05060><WTH8689>: let not the buyer<WH07069><WTH8802> rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799>, nor the seller<WH04376><WTH8802> mourn<WH056><WTH8691>: for wrath<WH02740> <FI>is<Fi> upon all the multitude<WH01995> thereof.

For the seller<WH04376><WTH8802> shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799> to that which is sold<WH04465>, although they were yet alive<WH02416>: for the vision<WH02377> <FI>is<Fi> touching the whole multitude<WH01995> thereof, <FI>which<Fi> shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799>; neither shall any<WH0376> strengthen<WH02388><WTH8691> himself in the iniquity<WH05771> of his life<WH02416>. <RF>although they...: Heb. though their life were yet among the living<Rf> <RF>in the...: or, whose life is in his iniquity<Rf> <RF>the iniquity: Heb. his iniquity<Rf>

They have blown<WH08628><WTH8804> the trumpet<WH08619>, even to make all ready<WH03559><WTH8687>; but none goeth<WH01980><WTH8802> to the battle<WH04421>: for my wrath<WH02740> <FI>is<Fi> upon all the multitude<WH01995> thereof.

The sword<WH02719> <FI>is<Fi> without<WH02351>, and the pestilence<WH01698> and the famine<WH07458> within<WH01004>: he that <FI>is<Fi> in the field<WH07704> shall die<WH04191><WTH8799> with the sword<WH02719>; and he that <FI>is<Fi> in the city<WH05892>, famine<WH07458> and pestilence<WH01698> shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> him.<CM>

But they that escape<WH06403><WTH8804> of them shall escape<WH06412>, and shall be on the mountains<WH02022> like doves<WH03123> of the valleys<WH01516>, all of them mourning<WH01993><WTH8802>, every one<WH0376> for his iniquity<WH05771>.
All hands<WH03027> shall be feeble<WH07503><WTH8799>, and all knees<WH01290> shall be weak<WH03212><WTH8799> <FI>as<Fi> water<WH04325>. <RF>be weak...: Heb. go into water<Rf>

They shall also gird<WH02296><WTH8804> <FI>themselves<Fi> with sackcloth<WH08242>, and horror<WH06427> shall cover<WH03680><WTH8765> them; and shame<WH0955> <FI>shall be<Fi> upon all faces<WH06440>, and baldness<WH07144> upon all their heads<WH07218>.

They shall cast<WH07993><WTH8686> their silver<WH03701> in the streets<WH02351>, and their gold<WH02091> shall be removed<WH05079>: their silver<WH03701> and their gold<WH02091> shall not be able<WH03201><WTH8799> to deliver<WH05337><WTH8687> them in the day<WH03117> of the wrath<WH05678> of the LORD<WH03068>: they shall not satisfy<WH07646><WTH8762> their souls<WH05315>, neither fill<WH04390><WTH8762> their bowels<WH04578>: because it is the stumblingblock<WH04383> of their iniquity<WH05771>. <RF>removed: Heb. for a separation, or, uncleanness<Rf> <RF>it is...: or, their iniquity is their stumblingblock<Rf>

As for the beauty<WH06643> of his ornament<WH05716>, he set<WH07760><WTH8804> it in majesty<WH01347>: but they made<WH06213><WTH8804> the images<WH06754> of their abominations<WH08441> <FI>and<Fi> of their detestable things<WH08251> therein: therefore have I set<WH05414><WTH8804> it far<WH05079> from them. <RF>set it far...: or, made it unto them an unclean thing<Rf>

And I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> it into the hands<WH03027> of the strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> for a prey<WH0957>, and to the wicked<WH07563> of the earth<WH0776> for a spoil<WH07998>; and they shall pollute<WH02490><WTH8765> it.

My face<WH06440> will I turn<WH05437><WTH8689> also from them, and they shall pollute<WH02490><WTH8765> my secret<WH06845><WTH8803> <FI>place<Fi> : for the robbers<WH06530> shall enter<WH0935><WTH8804> into it, and defile<WH02490><WTH8765> it. <RF>robbers: or, burglers<Rf><CM>
Make<WH06213><WTH8798> a chain<WH07569>: for the land<WH0776> is full<WH04390><WTH8804> of bloody<WH01818> crimes<WH04941>, and the city<WH05892> is full<WH04390><WTH8804> of violence<WH02555>.

Wherefore I will bring<WH0935><WTH8689> the worst<WH07451> of the heathen<WH01471>, and they shall possess<WH03423><WTH8804> their houses<WH01004>: I will also make the pomp<WH01347> of the strong<WH05794> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689>; and their holy places<WH06942><WTH8764> shall be defiled<WH02490><WTH8738><WTH8676><WH05157><WTH8765>. <RF>their holy...: or, they shall inherit their holy places<Rf>
Destruction<WH07089> cometh<WH0935><WTH8804>; and they shall seek<WH01245><WTH8765> peace<WH07965>, and <FI>there shall be<Fi> none. <RF>Destruction: Heb. Cutting off<Rf>

Mischief<WH01943> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon mischief<WH01943>, and rumour<WH08052> shall be upon rumour<WH08052>; then shall they seek<WH01245><WTH8765> a vision<WH02377> of the prophet<WH05030>; but the law<WH08451> shall perish<WH06><WTH8799> from the priest<WH03548>, and counsel<WH06098> from the ancients<WH02205>.

The king<WH04428> shall mourn<WH056><WTH8691>, and the prince<WH05387> shall be clothed<WH03847><WTH8799> with desolation<WH08077>, and the hands<WH03027> of the people<WH05971> of the land<WH0776> shall be troubled<WH0926><WTH8735>: I will do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto them after their way<WH01870>, and according to their deserts<WH04941> will I judge<WH08199><WTH8799> them; and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>according...: Heb. with their judgments<Rf><CM>
